title: Re-Fear Uber Widow Maker
description: Re-Fear Uber Widow Maker — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Sir Tified Luhny

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill 15 Fire Fade Bone Collectors, 3 Fire Fade Bone Collector Leaders, 15 Ember Devastators, 15 Toxic Raythes, 3 Toxic Raythe Leaders, 15 Toxic Haunts, 15 Toxic Manglers, and 3 Toxic Mangler Leaders and Return to Sir Tified Luhny on Level 5 of Widower's Nest.

Quest Reward: Gold and 4 King's Coins

Return to: Sir Tified Luhny

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Widower's Nest

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kill 15 Fire Fade Bone Collectors, 3 Fire Fade Bone Collector Leaders, 15 Ember Devastators, 15 Toxic Raythes, 3 Toxic Raythe Leaders, 15 Toxic Haunts, 15 Toxic Manglers, and 3 Toxic Mangler Leaders and Return to Sir Tified Luhny on Level 5 of Widower's Nest.

Offer:

Time to set the High Score, Dungeon Runner. The last Dungeon Runner to do this quest beat your last score. Do you think you can top it? Pride is on the line here, I don't have to tell you that, but pride is on the line here.

Get out there and kill those Fades and Demon Spawn before they resurrect Uber Widow Maker and then no one can farm her! If that happened, you would never be allowed to post on the ol' Townston Bulletin Board again for fear of getting flamed to death!

This list is a little longer than usual, so I'll put together an Org Chart for you to look at if you are having problems finding these creatures.

Creatures Found in the Dungeons off of Upper Widower's Nest: Fire Bone Collectors, Fire Bone Collector Leaders, Ember Devastators, Toxic Raythes, Toxic Raythe Leaders, Toxic Haunts, Toxic Manglers, and Toxic Mangler Leaders.

Creatures Found in Lower Widower's Nest: Ember Devastators, Toxic Raythes, Toxic Haunts, and Toxic Haunt Leaders.

Find and kill these creatures before it is too late and Uber Widow Maker again roams this dungeon! Oh, and hurry because I am meeting up with some buddies to make a few runs at the Widow Maker before you screw up an unleash Uber Widow Maker. Until then you can find me, Sir Tified Luhny, here on Level 5 of the Widower's Nest. Goodbye and have a pleasant respawn.

Turn-in:

Incredible, Dungeon Runner. You are an example to us all! I see a token there, does that mean you are ready to go again?

Objectives:

  • Slain Fire Bone Collectors
  • Slain Fire Bone Collector Leaders
  • Slain Ember Devastators
  • Slain Toxic Raythes
  • Slain Toxic Raythe Leaders
  • Slain Toxic Haunts
  • Slain Toxic Haunt Leaders
  • Slain Toxic Manglers
  • Slain Toxic Mangler Leaders

Level range: 25–40
